title: PhaseGate CLI for traffic ramp and proactive rollback
creator: Asha Menon
description:
Goal: Build PhaseGate — a lightweight CLI and orchestration helper that codifies progressive delivery policies (canaries, percentage ramps, flag-driven cohorts) and automates safety checks, rollback simulations, and post-deploy health validations.

Rationale: We currently rely on a mix of internal scripts, console manual steps, and ad-hoc dashboards for phased rollouts. That creates cognitive load for SREs/PMs and increases human error during LTS promotions. PhaseGate should offer a repeatable, testable interface for release engineers and platform operators to define ramps, attach SLO/metric gates, run dry-run simulations, and trigger controlled rollbacks or dialbacks automatically.

Scope:
- CLI that accepts a declarative "phasefile" describing cohorts, ramp curves, and gate thresholds (percent ramp schedule, min-req success rate, latency percentiles, error budgets).
- Integrations: feature-flagging system (FF-as-a-service), traffic router API, and telemetry (Prometheus/Tracing).
- Safety primitives: circuit-breaker thresholds, entropy-window sampling to avoid correlated failures, and automatic rollback scorer.
- Simulation harness to run ramp scenarios against historical telemetry (backtest) and stochastic fault injection (chaos scenarios).
- Preflight checks: model variant compatibility, KV-cache warmup estimate, and capacity reservation probe for Dedicated.
- Audit trail: produce an append-only rollout record with timestamps, metrics snapshots, decisions, and links to the console for investigative follow-up.

Success metrics:
- Reduce manual steps for staged release by 60% for platform team runbooks within first quarter after launch.
- Decrease mean time-to-rollforward for canary ramps by 30% and mean time-to-rollback by 20%.
- All PhaseGate-initiated rollouts must emit an audit record and be traceable via run_id in Console.

Non-goals:
- Full replacement of existing orchestration for large-scale automated promotions (will interoperate, not replace).
- UI console implementation (this ticket focuses CLI + APIs + backend policy evaluator).

Open questions / trade-offs:
- Where to draw line between CLI vs. controller: initial phase will be operator-driven CLI; later we may add a persistent controller for continuous rollouts.
- Declarative language complexity: start with minimal phasefile schema and iterate based on ops feedback.
- Rollback aggressiveness: conservative defaults, with option to opt into aggressive auto-rollback for low-risk services.

Artifacts:
- Design doc: https://confluence.internal.redwood/PhaseGate-design (working draft)
- Backtest harness prototype: https://github.com/redwood/phasegate-backtest (branch: proof-of-concept)
updates: 2026-03-10 - Asha Menon: Initial scoping + design doc drafted. Included schema sketch for phasefile (cohorts, ramp_curve, gates). Requested alignment with security for audit requirements.

2026-03-11 - Liam Chen: Spike complete for traffic router integration (router-v2 supports weighted cohorts). Verified API can accept percentage buckets and tag run_id metadata. Identified need for preflight capacity probe to avoid overload on Dedicated pools.

2026-03-11 - SRE Review (notes): Recommended adding entropy-window sampling to avoid correlated client bursts during small percentage ramps (see linked appendix). Suggested default gate: 95th latency < baseline*1.15 and error_rate < 0.5% for first 10% cohort.

2026-03-12 - Product feedback (Maya Patel): Ask to support LTS promotions: flag-level mapping so an LTS channel promotion can be expressed as an ordered series of PhaseGate steps with longer dwell times and stricter gates.

2026-03-12 - Liam Chen: Implemented prototype CLI scaffold and phasefile parser. Created PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4782. CI currently failing on integration tests against mock telemetry service.
2026-03-12 - Security (Ana Rodriguez): Audit trail format approved. Need KMS key for signing rollout manifests in Private deployments; added dependency ENG-352950.
2026-03-12 - Plan next: Harden backtest harness to replay 30 days of production P95/P99 traces and run chaos injection scenarios; iterate phasefile schema with Operator team in 2026-W11 sync.
